GREETING.text: Hello! I'm KharjaBot. Tell me what you're looking for: a coffee shop, a restaurant, a family outing?
Hi there! Give me a city, a category or a mood and I'll find a place.
Welcome! I can suggest places and share their hours, menu or contact.

THANKS.text: You're welcome! Ask me anytime to refine your search.
Happy to help! Want more outing ideas?
Glad I could help. Enjoy your outing!

DISCOVER_SUCCESS.text: I found {count} place(s) matching your search:
{count} option(s) look great for your outing:

DISCOVER_EMPTY.text: I couldn't find any place for those criteria. Try another city or category.
No results for now. Want me to widen the search to another city?
Nothing available with these filters. Shall we drop one?

ASK_MORE_CRITERIA.text: To help you better, which city and what kind of place are you after?
Tell me more: a city, a category (coffee, restaurant, beach...) or a budget?
Which city, and what kind of outing?

UNKNOWN.text: I didn't quite get that. Could you mention a city or a type of place?
Could you rephrase? For example: "a restaurant in Sousse".
Not sure I follow. Are you looking for a coffee shop, a restaurant or an activity?
